points.quote: They live next to the code, in `src/vs/*/test/{common,browser,node,electron-main}/*.test.ts`.
Run them with `scripts/test.sh` or `scripts\test.bat`, which uses Electron. Add `--run <file>` or `--grep` to narrow the run.
`npm run test-browser` runs the browser-targeted tests in Playwright. `npm run test-node` runs the node-only tests with mocha.
They live in `test/integration/electron` and `test/integration/browser`. ... Run them with `scripts/test-integration.sh` (or `.bat`).

They also include extension-host tests that run inside a real VS Code instance. Examples are the API tests in `extensions/vscode-api-tests` and other tests under `extensions/`. Run them with `scripts/test-integration.sh` (or `.bat`).
They live in `test/smoke`. They drive the built app with UI automation, built on `test/automation`. Run them with `npm run smoketest`, which compiles first.
The shared harness is in `test/unit/`. ... They live in `test/integration/electron` ... They live in `test/smoke`. ... `test/sanity` holds sanity tests of the built product.
